snippet.title: Alisa The Parting ► Premiere At Top Hat Studios Showcase
snippet.description:
A follow-up to 2021's Alisa, Alisa: The Parting is an unforgettable action packed adventure that plays and looks exactly like a late 90s-early 2000s survival-action title, with crispy pixely polygons, pre-rendered backgrounds, and cinematics. Coming soon.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3547910
